name: AtomStack A70 Max
tagline: 70–77W CoS-packaged diode: 850×800 mm flagship Atomstack cutter
tldr: AtomStack A70 Max brings 70–77W compressed diode power to an 850×800 mm frame with auto-focus, touchscreen, and claims of 25 mm wood in one pass. Popular 2024–2025 upgrade path for makers outgrowing A40 Pro: still open-frame, not enclosed.
mainObjective: Maximum Atomstack diode power for large panels and deep wood cuts

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Strongest cut headroom in the line: about 28 mm basswood-class stock in benchmarks
70W: the most cut-focused head in the AtomStack A70 Max line
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers AtomStack A70 Max. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Large-format high-power diode for production-style wood and acrylic cutting plus detailed engraving.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A70 Max 70W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.
